Privacy Notice – MintyRobot App and Service

Version: 1.0
Effective date: 1 December 2026
Relationship to other documents: This notice supplements the general Netová pomoc Privacy Policy at https://netovapomoc.sk/ochrana-osobnych-udajov. For the MintyRobot app and service, this notice prevails.

In short: We use your data to build and manage your website. We do not sell it or use it for third-party advertising. Part of the work is done by artificial intelligence (OpenAI, Anthropic) – they do not use your data to train their models. You can delete your account with one button in the app; we delete most data within 30 days and keep only what the law requires or what we need to defend legal claims.

1. Who processes your data

Controller: Netova pomoc s. r. o., Karpatské námestie 7770/10A, 831 06 Bratislava – Rača, Slovakia, company ID 54 630 649, registered in the Commercial Register of the Municipal Court Bratislava III, Section Sro, Insert No. 161114/B ("we").

Privacy contact: nikol@netovapomoc.sk, phone +421 950 244 327, in the app Account → Help.

We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer because Article 37 GDPR does not require us to; the contact above handles all questions.

2. Who this notice applies to

  • users of the MintyRobot app (web, iOS, Android) and MintyRobot clients, including the trial,
  • persons the client mentions in the questionnaire (e.g. contact person, people in photographs).

Visitors and customers of the client's website: we process their data (forms, bookings, traffic measurement) on behalf of the client as a processor; the client is the controller and information is in the privacy notice on the client's website. The terms are set out in Annex 2 of the MintyRobot Terms of Service.

3. What data we process, why and for how long

Data Source Purpose Legal basis (GDPR) Retention
Account: e-mail, name, language, sign-in codes, signed-in sessions you, at sign-in sign-in, account management, service communication Art. 6(1)(b) – contract and pre-contractual steps codes a few minutes until used/expired; sessions until sign-out or expiry; account until deletion (section 6)
Business details from onboarding: name, sector, website goal, city, domain, whether you already measure traffic, your Google Analytics ID / Meta Pixel ID you preparing the website preview, deploying measurement Art. 6(1)(b) during the contract and 30 days after it ends

Voice recording (optional) and its transcript you, in the questionnaire speech-to-text (OpenAI Whisper) and sorting content into questionnaire fields (Anthropic Claude) Art. 6(1)(a) – consent given before the first recording, withdrawable at any time; transcript once inserted into the questionnaire Art. 6(1)(b) audio only while being transcribed, at most 30 days; transcript as part of the questionnaire
Files: logo, photographs, documents you use on the website Art. 6(1)(b) during the contract and 30 days after it ends
Photographs of people for AI visuals you creating visuals Art. 6(1)(b) towards you; the client obtains consent of the persons depicted as files

Website admin change log (user, time, action, IP address) your website security, finding the cause of errors Art. 6(1)(f) – legitimate interest in security and defence of claims at most 12 months
App technical data: IP address, device type, app version, error logs your device security, fixing bugs Art. 6(1)(f) at most 90 days
On-device data: selected language, sign-in token, cached interface translations your device app functionality Art. 6(1)(b); Art. 5(3) ePrivacy Directive (strictly necessary for a service you requested) until sign-out or uninstall
Push notifications (device token) – once the feature is enabled your device alerts about website and request status Art. 6(1)(b); permission in your device settings until notifications are disabled or the account is deleted
E-mails about our other services your contact details offers of similar services (e.g. higher plan, AI Marketing+) Art. 6(1)(f) and the "existing customer" exemption under Slovak electronic communications law – you can opt out at any time until you opt out, at most 2 years after the contract ends

AI interface translation sends only the app's button and label texts to AI, not your data.

Providing data is voluntary, but without the data needed for the contract we cannot build or manage your website. We never see payment card details – they are processed by Lemon Squeezy.

4. Artificial intelligence

  • To build the website and process the questionnaire and requests we use AI models from OpenAI (speech transcription) and Anthropic (Claude – sorting answers, drafting texts, the AI worker and the assistant Aika). Before your data is first sent to AI, the app informs you and asks for your permission.
  • Under these providers' contractual terms, data sent through their APIs is not used to train their models. OpenAI retains API inputs and outputs for abuse monitoring for up to 30 days unless the law requires longer; Anthropic automatically deletes API inputs and outputs within 30 days (exceptions for usage policy violations or legal obligations).
  • AI does not make decisions about you that have legal or similarly significant effects (Article 22 GDPR). AI results are reviewed by a human before publication, and you see them and can correct them.
  • Please do not enter special categories of data (e.g. health data) in the questionnaire unless essential for your website. We do not use voice recordings to identify a person by their voice; they are not biometric data.

5. Who we share data with

We do not sell data. We share it only with processors providing services to us under an Article 28 GDPR agreement, and with the independent controllers listed below.

Independent controllers:

  • Lemon Squeezy (Lemon Squeezy LLC, Stripe group, USA) – as seller (Merchant of Record) processes payments, payment data, invoicing and taxes under its own privacy policy (lemonsqueezy.com/privacy). It passes subscription data to us (name, e-mail, country, plan, payment status).
  • Apple and Google – if you download the app from the App Store or Google Play, they process download data under their own policies.
  • Public authorities, courts and our lawyer – only where required by law or to defend legal claims.

Each processor is contractually bound to protect data to the same or a higher standard than described in this notice.

Transfers outside the EEA: Some providers are based in the USA. Transfers rely on the European Commission's adequacy decision for the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework (where the recipient is certified) or on standard contractual clauses (Article 46 GDPR). We will provide a copy of the safeguards on request.

6. Account deletion

Delete your account in the app: Account → Delete account (or via the web link https://mintyrobot.com/delete-account if the app is not installed). Before deletion we offer an export of your texts, photographs and answers.

6.1 Immediately after confirmation:

  • all sign-ins and sign-in codes are revoked and the account can no longer be used,
  • the Lemon Squeezy subscription is cancelled (no further payment is charged),
  • the website and business mailboxes (if running) are switched off,
  • the app clears data stored on your device (on sign-out).

6.2 Within 30 days we delete:

  • your profile in our database (Airtable) and in n8n tables,
  • questionnaire answers, transcripts and any audio recordings,
  • files on Google Drive,
  • request history and app communication,
  • the website, its database and mailboxes,
  • the Google Analytics property and the Search Console site (Google keeps them in its trash for a period under its own rules before removing them),
  • we also send deletion requests to processors holding the data.

6.3 What remains and why:

  • backups of the website and databases – deleted in the normal backup rotation cycle, at the latest within 30 days; we do not restore data from backups,
  • contract record (name, e-mail, plan, payment history, consents, withdrawal, complaints and their handling) – until the limitation period expires: 3 years for consumers (Section 101 Slovak Civil Code), 4 years for businesses (Section 397 Slovak Commercial Code), from the end of the contract; if there is a dispute, until it ends; legal basis Art. 6(1)(c) and (f),
  • accounting records – if we invoiced you directly for an add-on, we keep the invoice for 10 years (Section 35 of Slovak Act No. 431/2002 Coll. on Accounting). Subscription receipts are kept by Lemon Squeezy as seller under its own obligations,
  • website admin change log – up to 12 months from creation,
  • anonymised statistics that cannot identify you.

If you delete your account during a paid period, the unused part is not refunded, except as provided in Section 8 of the Terms of Service (14-day guarantee and withdrawal).

7. Trial without subscription

If you do not start a subscription after the trial, we switch off the website preview and delete your data (account, questionnaire, files, preview) 30 days after the trial ends, unless you ask us to delete it sooner. We keep your e-mail and a record that you used the trial for 12 months to prevent repeated misuse of the trial (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)).

8. Your rights

You have the right to:

  • access your data and obtain a copy (Art. 15 GDPR),
  • rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16),
  • erasure (Art. 17) – fastest by deleting your account in the app,
  • restriction of processing (Art. 18),
  • data portability of data you provided, in a machine-readable format (Art. 20),
  • object to processing based on legitimate interest and at any time to direct marketing (Art. 21),
  • withdraw consent at any time (e.g. for voice recording) without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing,
  • lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority: Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic, Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava 27, https://dataprotection.gov.sk, or the authority in your country of residence.

We handle requests without undue delay and at the latest within one month (Art. 12(3) GDPR). We may ask you to verify your identity, e.g. with a code sent to your account e-mail.

9. Security

Traffic between the app and the server is encrypted (HTTPS). You sign in with a one-time code, without a password. Only authorised team members and tools with configured permissions can access data; webhooks are protected by authentication and keys are not stored in code. Websites are backed up daily and their availability is monitored.

10. Children

The app and service are intended for adults (18+) and businesses. We do not knowingly process children's data.

11. Cookies and Google Analytics on mintyrobot.com

On mintyrobot.com we use analytics cookies of Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd., Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland). They are loaded only after you consent – until you click "Accept" in the cookie banner, Google Analytics does not run at all and nothing is sent to Google.

Cookie Purpose Expiry
_ga distinguishing visitors for traffic statistics 2 years
_ga_<ID> (e.g. _ga_P94LMB7QLD) keeping the visit (session) state 2 years
  • Purpose: website traffic statistics (how many people visit, where they came from, which pages they read). We do not use the data for advertising or profiling.
  • Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and Section 109(8) of Slovak Act No. 452/2021 Coll. on Electronic Communications).
  • Retention of data in Google Analytics: at most 14 months, after which Google deletes it automatically.
  • Transfer to the USA: Google LLC may process the data in the USA. The transfer relies on the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework, under which Google is certified, and on standard contractual clauses.
  • Withdrawing consent: at any time, as easily as you gave it – click the Cookies button at the bottom left of the website and choose "Reject". The analytics cookies are then deleted and measurement is switched off. Your choice is stored only in your browser (localStorage); withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing before it.

Apart from this, the website only uses strictly necessary browser storage (e.g. selected language, sign-in, your cookie choice), which does not require consent.

12. Changes

We may update this notice, e.g. when a processor or app feature changes. We will notify you of material changes in the app or by e-mail in advance. The current version is always in the app (Account → Privacy).
